mappedContracts.statement: Retire this prompt only after all of its content has been migrated into the canonical contract, Conductor, and GitHub issue systems with complete traceability.
acceptanceCriteria: A prompt-retirement check proves every prompt contract, phase, track, task, dependency rule, registry target, and roadmap item has an equivalent canonical record.
Deletion occurs in a dedicated final governance commit or PR and not in the initial planning PR.
The deletion receipt records the original prompt hash and replacement artefacts.
